section_title: Financial crime risks in relation to other types of risks > Case example: A lasting lesson

propositions.proposition: 在交易监控和合规框架不完善的情况下，银行可能允许大规模洗钱活动发生。
source_quotes: inadequate transaction monitoring and an overall fragmented and ineffective compliance framework
allowed drug cartels to launder over US$880 million

propositions.proposition: 当发生重大反洗钱合规违规时，监管机构可能处以创纪录的罚款。
source_quotes: In response to the breach
federal regulators imposed a record fine of US$1.9 billion

propositions.proposition: 在严重合规违规后，司法部可能达成延期起诉协议并要求全面整改银行的全球合规运营。
source_quotes: entered into a five-year deferred prosecution agreement
mandating a comprehensive overhaul of its global compliance operations

propositions.proposition: 重大的反洗钱调查可能导致包括全球合规主管在内的高级管理人员被迫辞职，反映出监管对银行金融犯罪防控文化的强烈批评。
source_quotes: forced resignation of several senior executives, including the Global Head of Compliance
reflecting the regulator’s strong criticism of the bank’s AFC culture

propositions.proposition: 如果银行内部将本地业务利益和利润置于严格的集中式合规控制之上，监管机构会认为其金融犯罪防控文化存在缺陷。
source_quotes: prioritized local business interests and profit over robust, centralized compliance controls
Regulators highlighted

propositions.proposition: 洗钱丑闻会引发即时的监管和财务反弹，造成持久声誉损害，削弱客户信任并降低市场地位。
source_quotes: trigger an immediate regulatory and financial backlash
inflicted lasting reputational damage
erosion of customer trust and a weakened market position

propositions.proposition: 在重大反洗钱失败后，银行可能被迫重组组织权力结构，加强中央监督和合规职能，限制地方业务部门的自主权，并采取去风险化策略以减少对高风险司法管辖区的敞口。
source_quotes: compelled to rebalance power dynamics
strengthening central oversight and compliance functions
limiting the autonomy of local business units
strategic de-risking process

propositions.proposition: 薄弱的金融犯罪控制会导致严重的财务处罚、运营中断和不可挽回的声誉损害，最终破坏银行的长期生存能力。
source_quotes: weak financial crime controls
severe financial penalties and operational disruption
irrevocably damages a bank’s reputation
undermining its long-term viability
